purpose: Prevent identity-review markers from being raised on normal, already-resolved, or insufficiently-investigated cases.

cases.expect: A missing/stale code lookup does not by itself create REVIEW/CONFLICT; search catalogue by normalized name/description and clinically meaningful specification before escalation.
Sibling lots of one local generic family may retain different valid CMS brands/codes when each lot independently maps to a compatible product identity.
A known department-specific code namespace absent from the central CMS catalogue is not a warning by itself; use departmental evidence or an authorized local catalogue extension.
Before creating or preserving a yellow/red marker, check whether current authoritative evidence already resolves the original issue; stale MSA markers become cleanup candidates.
Red is reserved for a current concrete incompatible identity, recycled-code contradiction, invalid source-vs-live conflict, or similarly blocked high-risk condition.
Yellow is used only when material uncertainty remains after code/name/specification/mapping/sibling/source reconciliation.
A near-expiry or expiry-helper ALERT does not justify a red/yellow identity marker when code/name/specification evidence is valid.
Every reported marker includes its reason in the same report item so the user does not need to search prior messages.
